purpose: Godot T3 deterministic combat rule vectors. These values define original-project behavior and are not imported from the Android implementation.

shield.priority: shield absorbs post-mitigation damage before health

damage_over_time.resolution: DOT is magic damage and ticks through the normal shield and magic-resistance path.

status.tick_rule: durations count down on each deterministic engine step and are removed at zero
status.stun: prevents automatic attacks and skill casts
status.silence: prevents skill casts but does not alter mana
status.slow: multiplies the next attack interval by 1.30
status.haste: multiplies the next attack interval by 0.70
